reviews.title: A total scam!! Beware
reviews.text: I should have followed the warnings that I read online prior to downloading this app. I bought a horoscope reading for about 7USD then realized they deducted 50 USD from my account. When I reached out to the customer service, it says they don’t have a cash back policy for my account, but can credit the amount to my Nebula account for consultation. They charged the amount I never agreed to pay and now they tell me they can’t refund. Beware guy, it’s a total scam! I wish I could give them zero!
